Let me reconsider — maybe the block is the PLAYER at (3,7), not the notice board. When I move right, the destination (3,7) is occupied by Player Tester. That would explain "blocked" for right. But up/down/left also fail.

Let me test up with blockedMs to see if it's also "blocked".
